b1-31-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Society in Twenty Years
b1-31-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks you over dinner in Budapest what you think society will be like in twenty years. You think it will change a lot and technology will have an important role.
b1-31-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what you think society will be like.
cues: Say what role technology will have
b1-31-01.target: La sociedad cambiará mucho y la tecnología tendrá un papel importante.
b1-31-01.english: Society will change a lot and technology will have an important role.
b1-31-01.canDo: I can make predictions about the future of society.

b1-31-02.title: Communicative Challenge: New Professions
b1-31-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks whether there will be new professions in the future. You think there probably will be, and that work may be different.
b1-31-02.prompt: Tell Meg how likely new professions are and that work may change.
cues: Say there will probably be new professions
Say it is possible that work will be different
b1-31-02.target: Probablemente habrá nuevas profesiones. Es posible que el trabajo sea muy diferente.
b1-31-02.english: There will probably be new professions. It is possible that work will be very different.
b1-31-02.canDo: I can express predictions with different levels of certainty.

b1-31-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What If?
b1-31-03.scenario: You are Meg. Your sister Kaylee asks what you and Carlos would do if he had no job at his office in Budapest. You say that you would have to adapt.
b1-31-03.prompt: Tell Kaylee what would happen and what you would do.
cues: Say what you would have to do
b1-31-03.target: Si Carlos no tuviera trabajo, tendríamos que adaptarnos.
b1-31-03.english: If Carlos had no job, we would have to adapt.
b1-31-03.canDo: I can discuss hypothetical changes and consequences.

b1-31-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Getting Ready
b1-31-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what the two of you should do to prepare for the coming years in Budapest. You say it is important to learn new skills and necessary to prepare.
b1-31-04.prompt: Tell Meg what is important and what is necessary.
cues: Say what is important to learn
Say what is necessary to do
b1-31-04.target: Es importante que aprendamos nuevas habilidades y es necesario que nos preparemos.
b1-31-04.english: It is important that we learn new skills and it is necessary that we prepare.
b1-31-04.canDo: I can discuss how society should prepare for change.

b1-31-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Calibán and Ariel
b1-31-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what the text about Rubén Darío says. In 1898 Darío called the United States Calibán, a country of force, money and machines, and put Ariel, art and ideals, with the Latin peoples. He asked the Latin nations to unite.
b1-31-05.prompt: Tell Carlos who Calibán is for Darío and what Darío asks of the Latin nations.
cues: Say what Ariel is for Darío
Say what Darío asks of the nations
b1-31-05.target: Darío llama Calibán a Estados Unidos, un país de dinero y máquinas. Ariel es el arte y las ideas, y Darío pide a los países de América que estén unidos.
b1-31-05.english: Darío calls the United States Calibán, a country of money and machines. Ariel is art and ideas, and Darío asks the countries of America to be united.
b1-31-05.canDo: I can discuss the future of society in a sustained way.

b1-31-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: An Uncertain Future
b1-31-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what you think about the next ten years. You say that there will probably be many changes, that you would have to adapt if they were fast, and that it is important to prepare.
b1-31-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what will probably happen and how to prepare.
cues: Say what you would do if it were fast
b1-31-consolidation.target: Probablemente habrá muchos cambios. Si fueran rápidos, tendríamos que adaptarnos, así que es importante que nos preparemos.
b1-31-consolidation.english: There will probably be many changes. If they were fast, we would have to adapt, so it is important that we prepare.
b1-31-consolidation.canDo: I can use the vocabulary of the future and probability.
